title: Fluidstack-led group to buy TeraWulf's 50.1% stake in Abernathy JV

sources.quote: Separately, TeraWulf has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its 50.1% ownership interest in the Abernathy Joint Venture to an investor group led by its joint venture partner, Fluidstack.

explain: An investor group led by Fluidstack agreed to buy TeraWulf's majority stake in their shared Abernathy, Texas data center venture. TeraWulf said the price is a premium to the roughly $450 million it invested, but did not give the exact amount.
